title: Desktop App Alpha
required_previous_checkpoint: accepted 0.0.9 Swappable Realtime Voice Frontend + Core Delegation source tree
scope: First native Electron/React Jarvis client: centered code-native avatar, progressive Realtime speech transcript, same-session typed input, and Realtime Mini + Cedar + WebRTC, while Python Jarvis Core remains authoritative and supervisable independently from the renderer.

desktop.runtime_api: mounted under /runtime for future UI growth

authority_invariants: Electron owns native lifecycle and may supervise exactly one local Core host; renderer lifecycle never reconstructs authoritative Core state
React owns presentation, client WebRTC media, progressive captions, and user input presentation only
OPENAI_API_KEY stays in trusted Python/Core and is never exposed to the renderer
Jarvis Core remains authoritative for durable memory, permissions, tools/actions, tasks, runtime state, delegated work, and backend intelligence routing
typed input and microphone input share the same Realtime conversation rather than creating separate UI-specific intelligence paths
Realtime Mini/Cedar/WebRTC remain replaceable provider/transport choices behind the 0.0.9 abstractions
known_limitations: 0.1.0 intentionally has no chat sidebar/history UI, settings UI, accounts, task panel, memory panel, or tool surfaces
the avatar is an intentionally simple code-native placeholder rather than final Jarvis visual identity
the desktop alpha is source-run only; installer/packaging/update distribution is deferred
the desktop session begins when the app launches; production wake/sleep and idle-cost lifecycle are deferred
authenticated remote/cloud Core and cross-device desktop/mobile clients are deferred
